subject: Human Rights Commission Modernization
overview: The committee approved a draft ordinance to modernize the Human Rights Commission with amendments regarding membership, stipends, and institutional independence. It also reviewed municipal newsletter drafts and early results from a public budget survey.

items.title: Human Rights Commission Modernization Ordinance
items.summary: The committee approved several amendments to the proposed ordinance, including set membership at 11 individuals and a $1,250 annual stipend for members. The committee further voted to retain the commission's power to remove members while allowing the mayor or council to request such removals, and the matter was referred to the full City Council.

items.title: City Council Newsletter
items.summary: Approved the draft newsletter with corrections to meeting dates and ordinance titles, and kept the matter in committee.

items.title: Municipal Budget Survey Results
items.summary: The committee reviewed early data from 92 respondents identifying schools and streets as primary budget priorities and voted to keep the survey open to improve demographic outreach. Councilor Tseng was requested to prepare a formal summary for the full council.
